info.title: Vantuch Content API
info.description: Read-only public content API for vantuch.dev. Only approved, published content is returned. Lists use deterministic cursor pagination: pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` until it is null. All timestamps are ISO 8601 in UTC; date-only filters are calendar days in Europe/Prague.

get.description: Defaults: city=brno, nearest upcoming first (including events still running), limit 20 (max 100). `freeFood=true` returns only events whose source explicitly confirms free food.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City (case and diacritics insensitive). Use `all` for every city.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Events starting or still running at/after this point. Dates are calendar days in Europe/Prague. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Events starting before the end of this day (Europe/Prague) or before this timestamp.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search in title, summary, venue, and organizer.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size (1–100).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from `nextCursor` of the previous page. Only valid with the same sort.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Default: nearest upcoming first.

parameters.name: free
parameters.description: `true`: free admission; `false`: explicitly paid.

parameters.name: freeFood
parameters.description: `true`: only events whose source explicitly confirms free food (`freeFood: yes`).

Cache-Control.description: Shared caches may keep the response for 300 seconds.

ETag.description: Weak validator; send If-None-Match for 304 responses.
